description: Test whether the CrtB hydrophobic patch is the active-site channel mouth, and assemble the summary figure
code:
import numpy as np, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def parse(path,trim=None):
    A=[]
    for l in open(path):
        if l.startswith("ENDMDL"): break
        if not l.startswith("ATOM") or l[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
        el=(l[76:78].strip() or l[12:16].strip()[0])
        if el=="H": continue
        ri=int(l[22:26])
        if trim and ri>trim: continue
        A.append((ri,l[17:20].strip(),l[12:16].strip(),el,np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])))
    return A
at=parse("struct/CrtB_PANAN_AF.pdb")
cen={}
for ri,rn,an,el,x in at: cen.setdefault(ri,[]).append(x)
cen={k:np.mean(v,0) for k,v in cen.items()}
prot_cen=np.mean(list(cen.values()),0)

patch=[7,11,14,21,22,24,28,36,37,39,40,43,142,146,150,164,168,234,237,245,246,248,252,255]
catal=[47,48,51,52,176,179,180]          # two Asp-rich motifs
cat_cen=np.mean([cen[i] for i in catal],0)
R=np.array([np.linalg.norm(cen[i]-prot_cen) for i in cen])   # radial distance of every residue
rad_all=np.array([np.linalg.norm(cen[i]-prot_cen) for i in sorted(cen)])
print("distance of each patch residue to the catalytic Asp-rich centroid (A):")
d_patch=np.array([np.linalg.norm(cen[i]-cat_cen) for i in patch])
for i,d in zip(patch,d_patch): print(f"  {i:4d} {d:5.1f}")
d_all=np.array([np.linalg.norm(cen[i]-cat_cen) for i in sorted(cen) if i not in patch and i not in catal])
import scipy.stats as st
print("\npatch mean dist to active site = %.1f A (n=%d); all other residues = %.1f A (n=%d)"%(d_patch.mean(),len(d_patch),d_all.mean(),len(d_all)))
print("Mann-Whitney (patch closer to active site): U=%.0f p=%.3g"%st.mannwhitneyu(d_patch,d_all,alternative="less"))
print("patch residues within 16 A of active-site centroid: %d/%d"%((d_patch<16).sum(),len(d_patch)))

# radial position: surface vs cavity
rp=np.array([np.linalg.norm(cen[i]-prot_cen) for i in patch])
print("\nradial distance from protein centroid: patch mean %.1f A, all residues mean %.1f A (surface shell ~ %.1f A)"%(rp.mean(),rad_all.mean(),np.percentile(rad_all,90)))

# ---------------- summary figure ----------------
bench=json.load(open("struct/_bench.json"))
cons=np.load("struct/_conserv.npz")
idf=cons["idfrac"]
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,8.6))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,3,hspace=.42,wspace=.3)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:2])
order={"cytosolic":0,"homolog":1,"monotopic":2,"query":3}
col={"cytosolic":"#8d99a6","homolog":"#3b7dd8","monotopic":"#c0392b","query":"#e08a1e"}
b=sorted(bench,key=lambda r:(order[r["cls"]],r["patch"]))
ax.barh([r["name"] for r in b],[r["patch"] for r in b],color=[col[r["cls"]] for r in b])
cy=[r["patch"] for r in bench if r["cls"]=="cytosolic"]
ax.axvline(np.mean(cy),ls="--",c="k",lw=.9); ax.text(np.mean(cy)+8,0.2,"cytosolic mean 373 $\\AA^2$",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("largest contiguous exposed apolar side-chain patch ($\\AA^2$)")
ax.set_title("CrtB has a large hydrophobic patch, but inside the cytosolic range\n(monotopic vs cytosolic: Mann-Whitney p = 0.024; CrtB z = +0.94 vs cytosolic null, p = 0.17)",fontsize=10)
ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,2])
grp=[[r["patch"] for r in bench if r["cls"]==c] for c in ["cytosolic","homolog","monotopic"]]
ax.boxplot(grp,labels=["cytosolic\n(n=15)","SQS/CrtM\n(n=3)","monotopic\n(n=4)"],widths=.55)
ax.scatter([1.0],[503],marker="*",s=220,color="#e08a1e",zorder=5,label="CrtB P21683 (503 $\\AA^2$)")
ax.set_ylabel("largest apolar patch ($\\AA^2$)"); ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)
ax.set_title("Benchmark distribution",fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
rest=[i+1 for i in range(309) if (i+1) not in patch and (i+1) not in catal]
ax.boxplot([idf[[i-1 for i in patch]],idf[[i-1 for i in catal]],idf[[i-1 for i in rest]]],
           labels=["patch\n(n=24)","Asp-rich\n(n=7)","rest\n(n=278)"],widths=.55)
ax.set_ylabel("identity to P21683 across 147 bacterial CrtB")
ax.set_title("Patch residues are conserved\n(patch vs rest p = 4.0e-4)",fontsize=10); ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
ax.hist(d_all,bins=22,color="#c9ced4",label="all other residues")
ax.hist(d_patch,bins=12,color="#e08a1e",alpha=.85,label="patch residues")
ax.axvline(np.median(d_patch),color="#e08a1e",ls="--")
ax.set_xlabel("distance to Asp-rich active-site centroid ($\\AA$)"); ax.set_ylabel("residues")
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.set_title("Patch clusters on the active-site face",fontsize=10); ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,2])
hel=json.load(open("struct/_crtB_helrows.json"))
x=[h["meanH"] for h in hel]; y=[h["muH"] for h in hel]
ax.scatter(x,y,s=40,color="#3b7dd8")
for h in hel:
    if h["muH"]>0.29: ax.annotate(f"{h['start']}-{h['end']}",(h["meanH"],h["muH"]),fontsize=7,xytext=(4,2),textcoords="offset points")
ax.axhline(0.50,ls="--",c="#c0392b"); ax.text(-0.55,0.515,"typical lipid-binding\namphipathic helix",fontsize=7.5,color="#c0392b")
ax.set_xlabel("mean hydrophobicity <H>"); ax.set_ylabel("hydrophobic moment $\\mu_H$")
ax.set_title("No CrtB helix reaches $\\mu_H$ > 0.5",fontsize=10); ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)
plt.show()
